utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Thanks for calling Tangent Broadband sales. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: Hi Alex, I'm looking to switch my home internet. My current provider is iPRIMUS and I want a cheaper plan.

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: I can certainly help you with that switch from iPRIMUS. May I please confirm your full name and service address?

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: Yes, my name is [CUSTOMER_NAME] and the address is [SERVICE_ADDRESS].

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Thank you [CUSTOMER_NAME]. Looking up your address, you have FTTP available at the premises.

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Our Home Starter plan offers a typical download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 8.5 Mbps.

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: That speed is fine for my needs. How much is the plan?

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: The promotional price is $42.90 per month for the first 6 months, and then the regular price will be $72.90 per month thereafter.

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: Does it come with a modem or do I have to pay extra for one?

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: We include the Netcom CF40 Wi-Fi 6 modem. The modem cost is $0, completely free on this plan.

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: That sounds great. When can the modem be delivered to me?

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Standard delivery takes between 3 to 5 business days from dispatch.

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: And when would the new connection become active?

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: We will schedule the connection as soon as possible once your transfer request clears.

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Just to note the statutory disclosure, the minimum total cost over the first 6 months under this promotion is $317.

utterances.speaker: CUSTOMER
utterances.text: Understood. Let's proceed with setting that up. My phone number is [PHONE_NUMBER].

utterances.speaker: AGENT
utterances.text: Perfect, thank you [CUSTOMER_NAME]. I have submitted your order and you will receive a confirmation email shortly.
